name: eyebrow
label: Eyebrow
help_text: Small uppercase label above the heading. Leave blank to hide it (and its gold rule).

name: show_eyebrow_rule
label: Show Gold Rule
help_text: A short gold rule above the eyebrow. Works with or without eyebrow text.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Visual size, independent of the heading level. Follows theme typography.

name: animate_heading
label: Type Heading On Scroll
help_text: The heading types itself in the first time it scrolls into view. Plays once, and is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

name: description
label: Description
default: A CRM implementation shouldn't start with creating properties and pipelines. It starts with questions — and we map the answers before we build the system.

name: rows
label: Rows
help_text: Each row renders as an icon plus a line of text, separated by a hairline rule.

children.name: icon
children.label: Icon
children.help_text: Optional. Leave blank for no icon on this row.

default.text: How does a lead become a customer?
Where does customer data come from?
What does management need to know?

name: row_text_size
label: Row Text Size
help_text: Visual size only, using the theme's type scale. Auto uses the tag's own size.

name: icon_color
label: Icon Color
help_text: Defaults to the body text colour.

name: row_spacing
label: Row Spacing
help_text: Vertical space inside each row. Uses the theme's spacer scale (Theme Settings > Padding & Spacers).

name: animate_rows
label: Reveal rows on scroll
help_text: Rows fade up in sequence as the section enters the viewport.

name: custom_column_size
label: Custom Column Widths
help_text: Off: the two columns split the row evenly, as SR's two-column modules do. On: set each column's width and offset yourself.

children.name: column_order
children.label: Order
children.help_text: Which column comes first at this breakpoint.

name: column_vertical_align
